title: Power of attorney to execute DEA Form 222
rule_summary: A DEA registrant may authorize one or more individuals to obtain and execute DEA Forms 222 by granting a compliant power of attorney; the power of attorney is retained and made available for inspection rather than submitted to DEA as each order is placed.
exam_relevance: Tests who may sign an executed paper Schedule I/II order and how that authority is documented.

authority.name: DEA Form 222 Q&A
authority.section: Who can sign executed DEA 222 Order Forms

common_confusions: Assuming only the person who signed the DEA registration may ever execute a Form 222.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
